slots.name: Squire's Cut
slots.description: Fast one-handed slash off the shoulder

slots.name: Barn Door
slots.description: Flat two-handed sweep across his front

slots.name: Pot-Lid Throw
slots.description: Skim the pot lid off his shoulder like a frisbee. It hits on the way out and on the way back, pulling fighters toward him, and he catches it. One lid: no second throw while it is out.

slots.name: Targeted Jump Slam
slots.description: Hold the GroundCursor ring, then release to jump to the clamped ground target and slam on landing.

slots.name: The Joust
slots.description: Rear your hobby horse, then gallop a long way with your plank couched as a lance, armoured and steered with the stick. The first fighter you meet is unhorsed; a miss skids to a stop. Off a ledge you gallop on thin air, look down and drop.

slots.name: Blade Storm
slots.description: Repeated hilt-to-tip greatsword slashes ending in a heavy finisher.

slots.name: Air Cleave
slots.description: A broad aerial sword cut that sends opponents outward.
